note: Every library the site knows. status: built (on the site) or queued (prepared; the weekly workflow builds it when the money rule allows), not-ready (failed its rubric audit; never built automatically). frozen: never grown. Read by backend/app/api/registry.py.

libraries.name: Language-model reliability
libraries.blurb: How language models express confidence, when they should refuse to answer, how their uncertainty is measured, and why they state false things as fact.

libraries.name: Diet and all-cause mortality
libraries.blurb: What the epidemiology and clinical-trial literature says about diet — food groups, dietary patterns, and specific regimes — and mortality-related outcomes.
libraries.not_advice_note: Research-literature analysis, not dietary or medical advice. Some papers here disagree with each other, for example on red meat and on alcohol (checked by hand, not by experts). Take medical decisions to a clinician who knows you.

libraries.name: Algorithmic fairness in machine learning
libraries.blurb: Definitions and metrics for fair machine-learning classifiers, incompatibility results between them, bias-mitigation methods, and audits of deployed systems.

libraries.name: Nudges and choice architecture
libraries.blurb: Whether defaults, reminders, social-norm messages and other changes to how choices are presented change what people do, and how large those effects really are.
libraries.not_advice_note: Research-literature analysis, not policy or professional advice.

libraries.name: Social media and adolescent mental health
libraries.blurb: What studies find about young people's social-media, smartphone and screen use and their depression, anxiety, loneliness and well-being, and why they disagree.
libraries.not_advice_note: Research-literature analysis, not medical, parenting or mental-health advice. If you or a young person you know is struggling, talk to a doctor or a local support service.

libraries.name: Ego depletion and self-control
libraries.blurb: Whether using self-control uses up a limited resource, and why large replication attempts disagree with the original findings.

libraries.name: Minimum wage and employment
libraries.blurb: What raising the minimum wage does to jobs, hours and earnings, and why careful studies reach different answers.
libraries.not_advice_note: Research-literature analysis, not economic, policy or employment advice.
libraries.not_ready_reason: Blind self-audit agreement 60% then 67% after the one allowed rubric fix (80% required): general labour-economics papers still enter as borderline. Needs a human rubric revision before it can be built (docs/findings/domain-selection-2026-10-09.md).

libraries.name: Growth-mindset interventions
libraries.blurb: Whether teaching students that ability can grow improves their learning and grades, for whom, and by how much.
libraries.not_advice_note: Research-literature analysis, not educational or parenting advice.

libraries.name: Deep reinforcement learning: evaluation and reproducibility
libraries.blurb: How deep reinforcement-learning results are measured, why many fail to reproduce, and which evaluation practices make comparisons trustworthy.
